principles: Send Gmail START and persist provider message_id before substantive work.
Target 23 minutes of substantial useful work inside a 25-minute wall-clock tranche; only a true human gate, safety/tool failure, or completed atomic boundary justifies materially earlier close.
Reserve the final 2 minutes for closeout and do not start new optional mutations once close reserve begins.
PRIMARY_ASSISTANT owns normal END delivery; no scheduled automation is required for normal close.
Persist CLOSE_INTENT, search Gmail by delivery_key, send END if missing, verify provider ACK/SENT readback, persist CLOSED, then reply in ChatGPT.
The UI thinking-duration indicator is not programmatically controllable; do not fabricate it. Durable commits/tests/readbacks/receipts prove work.
limitations: This policy guides BCP/project work; it cannot retroactively rewrite past ChatGPT conversations.
ChatGPT itself does not continue executing after a response unless invoked again; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.

measurement_truth.chatgpt_thinking_indicator: NOT_AUTHORITATIVE; MAY_BE MUCH SHORTER_THAN TOTAL_TOOL_ORCHESTRATION; NEVER_USED_AS_WORK_PROOF
